result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position: Customer may terminate on 30 days’ written notice and receives a refund of prepaid fees allocable to the post-termination period, while Kubient may terminate for convenience only at the end of a term on 90 days’ notice. The retained entitlement to fees during the notice period does not negate the post-termination refund. However, allowing termination of “any Exhibit,” “in whole or in part,” adds partial and exhibit-level termination rights not required by the playbook and creates avoidable scope ambiguity, so the redline is not minimal.
